taxonomy_note: Names and numbering follow the AEI's publicly published list of Gene Sharp's 198 methods. Category headings condensed; no assertion of CJP receiving direction or training.
scope: Movement-directed and publicly reported CJP-linked actions 16 May–15 October 2026, with allied acts explicitly tagged. Not comprehensive footage review.

status_definitions.documented: Dated reporting supports the physical or verbal act and a reasonable narrow fit to this Sharp category; not proof of AEI adoption.
status_definitions.possible: Suggestive but incomplete, indirect, different actor, or contested legal interpretation; do not count as confirmed.
status_definitions.announced: An eligible public statement described a contemplated act; actual occurrence not yet documented.
status_definitions.not_established: No qualifying method-specific evidence located in reviewed sources; absence of documentation is not disproof.

forecast.method_name: Displays of flags and symbolic colors
forecast.description: The next publicly reported CJP-linked action is more likely to repeat a flag display than introduce a reliably identifiable unused Sharp method, conditional on the reported October 16 gathering taking place.
forecast.basis: CJP organisers visibly displayed the tricolour on October 13. News reporting on October 14 describes a call for a tricolour gathering on October 16. The latter is a mobilisation report, not a verified completed act and not a newly admitted spoken CJP claim. The 15 October source review corroborates the planned 16 October tricolour action, not its execution; forecast is still open.
forecast.validation_rule: After October 16, check dated independent reports and visual evidence; mark confirmed, not observed, or unresolved. Do not automatically count a planned event as completed.
forecast.alternative: Method #47 Assemblies of protest or support, if people gather but flag-display evidence is absent.
forecast.next_novel_method_prediction: Not identified: no robust evidence supports predicting which previously unseen numbered method would be adopted next.

EPA agency caption records a CJP supporter taking part in a candlelight vigil at Jantar Mantar for students reportedly lost after medical entrance examinations. Single photograph documents participation, not organiser instructions or number of participants.
method_events.actor_scope: CJP supporter at movement gathering, per EPA photo caption

method_events.name: The fast
method_events.event: Hunger strike by Wangchuk and AISA students at CJP protest
method_events.explanation: Wangchuk and six AISA students began fasting in solidarity, not evidence CJP directly ordered them.

method_events.name: Deputations
method_events.event: CJP delegation meets J P Nadda
method_events.explanation: Das and Ranka met Union minister Nadda and handed a representation; this is a documented deputation, not proof of another relationship.

method_events.name: Marches
method_events.explanation: Contemporaneous chronology describes the march toward Parliament, major participation and clashes; peaceful and disputed acts must be distinguished.

method_events.name: Group lobbying
method_events.explanation: Das and Ranka met ministers regarding protest demands; counted as group lobbying, not proof of achieved concessions.

method_events.name: Literature and speeches advocating resistance
method_events.event: Public interview advocating continued civil resistance
method_events.explanation: Ranka stated an intention to persist with public civil disobedience against restrictions; this is speech, not evidence later acts occurred.

method_events.name: Assemblies of protest or support
method_events.explanation: CJP-linked gathering planned amid major restrictions; allied flash actions must not be treated as CJP organisational command.
method_events.actor_scope: CJP and distinct allied groups, roles separated

method_events.name: Displays of flags and symbolic colors
method_events.event: National flags displayed at Jantar Mantar
method_events.explanation: Reported CJP organisers displayed the tricolour while protesting. Police allege additional conduct; custody is not conviction.

method_events.name: Public Speeches
method_events.explanation: Indian Express account of Dipke speaking to reporters about group independence, protest legitimacy and disputing police claims.

method_events.name: Public Speeches
method_events.event: CJP West Zone coordinator appears on televised panel
method_events.explanation: India Today identifies Rohit Patel as a CJP West Zone coordinator participating alongside representatives of unrelated political groups; no joint command implied.

coverage_leads.description: Reported plan for Bengaluru human-chain protest, denied permission by police. No independent confirmation that event occurred, so not classified as documented action.

review_protocol.proposition_test: Method named, physical or public-verbal conduct tested against that exact definition; action before any later date announcement; actor scope established; source provenance; first documented date.
review_protocol.classification_limit: This is a limited-source comparison and categorisation exercise, not 198 separately authenticated archival investigations or proof that AEI methods were consciously followed.
